description: This file contains functions and type definitions for merging and managing provider configurations, including handling API keys, base URLs, and model settings within a larger application.

methods.name: isPositiveFiniteTokenLimit
methods.description: Checks if a value is a finite number greater than zero.

methods.name: resolvePreferredTokenLimit
methods.description: Resolves the preferred token limit based on explicit and implicit values.

methods.name: getProviderModelId
methods.description: Extracts and trims the 'id' field from a model object.

methods.name: mergeProviderModels
methods.description: Merges two provider configurations, combining models and headers, resolving token limits.

methods.name: mergeProviders
methods.description: Merges multiple provider configurations, handling key trimming and merging logic.

methods.name: resolveProviderApi
methods.description: Resolves the API string from a provider entry.

methods.name: resolveModelApiSurface
methods.description: Extracts and sorts API strings from models within a provider entry.

methods.name: resolveProviderApiSurface
methods.description: Resolves the API surface string from a provider or model configuration.

methods.name: shouldPreserveExistingApiKey
methods.description: Determines if the existing API key should be preserved based on markers and provider sets.

methods.name: shouldPreserveExistingBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines if the existing base URL should be preserved based on provider sets and API surface.

methods.name: mergeWithExistingProviderSecrets
methods.description: Merges new provider configurations with existing ones, preserving API keys and base URLs as needed.
